{{Top|leg}}
'''Permex''' was a versatile building material that consisted of [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]]-injected polymeric [[Plastic/Legends|plastic]]. Known for the ease of its production and pliability, permex could be combined with a number of light-reactive minerals to enhance its already considerable strength, resulting in the production of a material called [[Permacite/Legends|permacite]]. [[Klaus Vandangante/Legends|Klaus Vandangante]] utilized a few slabs of permex to construct a simple structure that held the office for his mobile [[Outlaw tech/Legends|outlaw tech]] base.

The [[Santhe/Sienar Technologies Corporate Headquarters]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]] utilized permex in its construction.<ref name="ML">''[[Mission to Lianna]]''</ref>
